author: Himmi Godiyal
text: Anuj Baluni Bhai is very good at service and attender behaviour is also very polite. Happy to visit here, a must-visit stay in Lansdowne for great memories!

author: Gaurav Chauhan
text: Had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The rooms were clean and comfortable, the staff was polite and helpful, and the overall experience was excellent. Special thanks to Anuj for his friendly and professional behaviour!

author: Ashish Jain
text: My experience at this hotel was absolutely wonderful. The ambience, food, and staff hospitality were perfect. I want to highly commend the manager, Anuj, for his exceptional hospitality from check-in to check-out!

author: Ankit & Priya
text: The valley view from our private balcony was worth the trip alone. The bonfire evening with the staff was a lovely surprise!

author: Rohit Malhotra
text: Good Indian food at the restaurant and the kids loved the play zone. Staff arranged a cab for us to Tarkeshwar temple with no hassle.

author: Siddharth Rawat
text: The group departure package from Delhi was seamless. The fairy lights on the outdoor lawn and DJ evening made our anniversary unforgettable.
